description: Find covered markets whose symbol, name or group contains the query, e.g. 'semiconductor', 'yen', 'india', 'gold'. Returns one line per match with its called count, invalidation price and page link.

query.description: Text to look for in market symbols, names and groups (case-insensitive substring), e.g. 'nvda', 'bitcoin', 'semiconductor', 'india'.

name: search_markets
title: Search markets
